definitions.short: Sin the name of an Egyptian town and (probably) desert adjoining
definitions.full: H5512. Ciyn I. סִין proper name, of a location Sin , i.e. Pelusium , east frontier city of Egypt (Egyptian ' Imt = clay , of which סין is translated (compare Aramaic סְיָן clay ), according to Steind BAS i. 599 , who compare II ηλούσιον ( πηλός = dirt, mud ), compare Brugsch Dict. Géogr. 1081 ff. ); — Ezek 30:15 ( ᵐ5 Σαιν accusative), + 30:16 , but here Co Toy read plausibly סון , i.e. סְוָן = Syene (see [ סְוָן ], סְוֵנֵה ), ᵐ5 συηνη . — On Pelusium see Bd Egypt.4 (1898), 169 . II. סִין proper name, of a location wilderness between Elim and Sinai , מִדְבַּרסִֿין , according to P, Exod 16:1 ; 17:1 ; Num 33:11 ; 3:12 ; ᵐ5 Σειν , A ᵐ5 L Σιν ; compare Eb GS 2. 155 ff. and especially Di Exod 16:1 .
